question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an empty JSON object with Content-Type application/json and Notion-Version 2025-09-03, the version the vendor's quickstart uses. This is the first call of the Custom Agents API, the one that lists the agents a token can reach

decoded.body: a JSON error object: object error, status 401, code unauthorized, with a message saying the Authorization header must carry a token in the documented scheme, plus the request id
decoded.no-challenge: no www-authenticate header at all, unlike the MCP surface on the same vendor's other host: the refusal is in the body and the status line only
decoded.not-measured: everything behind the credential, including whether an agent session can be started and what a Custom Agent answers

finding: Notion's Custom Agents API, in public beta at the time of this probe, refuses an unauthenticated caller with a 401 and a JSON error naming the header format it wants. It carries no www-authenticate challenge, so a client cannot discover an authorization server from the refusal the way it can from the MCP endpoint two hosts over; the vendor's quickstart says a personal access token or an internal connection's installation token is required, and that the API works only with Custom Agents that already exist in the workspace. This is the newest agent-facing surface this vendor publishes and it is credential-gated like the rest.
